## Contact Information

For general inquiries about the Somali Fish Stock Training Program, please use the form below or reach out directly:

- **Email:** [contact@tafiri.go.tz](mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz)
- **Program Coordination:** Tanzania Fisheries Research Institute (TAFIRI)
- **Training Period:** 6-24 December 2025

## Training Registration Form

If you're interested in participating in the training program, please fill out the registration form below. We'll get back to you with more details about the program.

::: {.callout-note}
## Setup Required

This form requires a free Web3Forms access key to function. See [SERVERLESS_FORM_SETUP.md](SERVERLESS_FORM_SETUP.md) for setup instructions. Alternatively, you can email your registration details directly to [contact@tafiri.go.tz](mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz).
:::

```{=html}
<form id="contact-form" class="needs-validation" novalidate>
  <div class="mb-3">

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');
  const btnText = document.getElementById('btn-text');
  const btnSpinner = document.getElementById('btn-spinner');
  const formMessage = document.getElementById('form-message');
  
  // Form validation
  form.addEventListener('submit', function(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    
    if (form.checkValidity()) {
      submitForm();
    }
    
    form.classList.add('was-validated');
  }, false);
  
  function submitForm() {
    // Disable button and show spinner
    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    btnText.classList.add('d-none');
    btnSpinner.classList.remove('d-none');
    formMessage.innerHTML = '';
    
    // Collect form data
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    const data = {};
    formData.forEach((value, key) => {
      data[key] = value;
    });
    
    // Using Web3Forms API (free tier)
    // IMPORTANT: Replace YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY with your actual access key from https://web3forms.com
    // See SERVERLESS_FORM_SETUP.md for detailed setup instructions
    const accessKey = "YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY";
    
    // Check if access key has been configured
    if (accessKey === "YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY") {
      formMessage.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert"><strong>Configuration Required:</strong> The form has not been configured yet. Please contact us directly at <a href="mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz">contact@tafiri.go.tz</a> or see <a href="SERVERLESS_FORM_SETUP.md">setup instructions</a>.</div>';
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      btnText.classList.remove('d-none');
      btnSpinner.classList.add('d-none');
      return;
    }
    
    data.access_key = accessKey;
    
    // Set timeout for fetch request (30 seconds)
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30000);
    
    fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
      signal: controller.signal
    })
    .then(response => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Server responded with status ${response.status}`);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      if (data.success) {
        formMessage.innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-success" role="alert"><strong>Success!</strong> Thank you for your registration. We will contact you soon with more details about the training program.</div>';
        form.reset();
        form.classList.remove('was-validated');
      } else {
        const errorMsg = data.message || 'Submission failed';
        throw new Error(errorMsg);
      }
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error('Error:', error);
      
      // Provide specific error messages based on error type
      let errorMessage = '<div class="alert alert-warning" role="alert">';
      
      if (error.name === 'AbortError') {
        errorMessage += '<strong>Request Timeout:</strong> The request took too long. Please check your internet connection and try again, or contact us directly at <a href="mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz">contact@tafiri.go.tz</a>.';
      } else if (error.message.includes('status')) {
        errorMessage += '<strong>Server Error:</strong> There was a problem with the server. Please try again in a few minutes, or contact us directly at <a href="mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz">contact@tafiri.go.tz</a>.';
      } else if (error.message.includes('Failed to fetch') || error.message.includes('NetworkError')) {
        errorMessage += '<strong>Connection Error:</strong> Unable to connect to the server. Please check your internet connection and try again, or contact us directly at <a href="mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz">contact@tafiri.go.tz</a>.';
      } else {
        errorMessage += '<strong>Submission Failed:</strong> ' + error.message + '. Please contact us directly at <a href="mailto:contact@tafiri.go.tz">contact@tafiri.go.tz</a> with your registration details.';
      }
      
      errorMessage += '</div>';
      formMessage.innerHTML = errorMessage;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      // Re-enable button and hide spinner
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      btnText.classList.remove('d-none');
      btnSpinner.classList.add('d-none');
    });
  }
})();
</script>

    border-color: #0d6efd;

  }

    background-color: #0b5ed7;

</style>
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who can participate?

The training is designed for fisheries officers, researchers, data collectors, and managers from across Somalia's coastal regions.

### What are the prerequisites?

Basic understanding of fisheries and interest in stock assessment. No prior technical experience required for most modules.

### Is there a cost to participate?

Please contact us for information about program costs and potential support options.

### What materials do I need?

All training materials will be provided. Participants should bring a laptop if possible.

### Will certificates be provided?

Yes, participants who complete the training will receive a Certificate of Competency in Fisheries Stock Assessment.
